source.title: Ashenvale Mission X: Dreamroot
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow and collect Dreamroot from within the Nightmare Incursions. We can harness its magic to reverse the damage. You will need the assistance of an herbalist.
source.objective: Gather 10 Dreamroot in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursions and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
